title: Make every typed plan reference resolve to a declared artifact

facts.note: Plan artifacts (wagons, features, WMBTs, trains, interlockings, journeys) are identifiable by path/file kind. This is the applicability prerequisite: the rule is an invariant over every typed reference in the plan.
Applies to all plan artifact files outside vendored/generated trees, whether or not they changed.
Full-plan validation/inspection runs over the whole plan regardless of what changed; authoring/editing are additional triggers.

Optional routing hint only, NOT an applicability prerequisite: a diff observer could prioritise added/changed typed references or removal/rename of a declared target. Unchanged unresolved references are still in scope.
The planner_plan_integrity validator reports unresolved typed references across the whole plan, including pre-existing ones.

fires: A planner writes a feature that references `wagon:<id>` where no wagon with that id is declared in the plan.
A WMBT or acceptance references `journey:<id>` or `wmbt:<id>` that was renamed or deleted elsewhere in the plan.
A train or interlocking artifact references a `feature:` or `train:` id that the plan does not declare.
Full-plan validation finds a pre-existing, unchanged typed reference that names no declared artifact, even though nothing in the current change touched it.
doesNotFire: A `contract:` reference — resolution is checked by the contract registry rules instead.
Files under `node_modules`, `dist`, `build` or `_generated` contain typed references — these trees are never scanned.
Every typed reference in the plan names an artifact the plan declares.

given: The plan contains typed references (`wagon:`, `feature:`, `wmbt:`, `train:`, `interlocking:`, `journey:`) in its artifacts, changed or not.
when: The plan is validated or inspected as a whole, or the planner authors, edits, removes or renames plan artifacts.
then: Every such typed reference must name an artifact the plan declares.
prefer: Declare the referenced artifact in the plan when the relationship is real.
Correct the reference to the actual declared id when it is a typo or stale after a rename.
When removing or renaming an artifact, update every typed reference that points to it in the same change.
avoid: Leaving references to nothing — a relationship the plan claims but cannot show.
Creating empty placeholder artifacts only to make a reference resolve without the relationship being real.
Treating `contract:` references under this rule; they belong to the contract registry rules.
unless: The reference lives in a vendored or generated tree (`node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, `_generated`); those are never scanned.
why: A reference to nothing is a relationship the plan claims and cannot show; unresolved references break plan traceability.
evidence: The planner_plan_integrity validator reports no unresolved typed references for the whole plan.
Reviewer can map each `wagon:`/`feature:`/`wmbt:`/`train:`/`interlocking:`/`journey:` reference to an artifact the plan declares.
verifier_detail: Realized by validator `planner_plan_integrity` (a package guard, not a canonical planner node).

Scanned reference prefixes: `wagon:`, `feature:`, `wmbt:`, `train:`, `interlocking:`, `journey:`. `contract:` is excluded (handled by contract registry rules). All typed references in scanned plan artifacts are checked, not only changed ones.
audit: schema_version 1.1.0; kind rule; status active; introduced_in 0.1.0.

Term package_rule: a rule of this package's own gates (`atdd-bun.*`), realized by a package guard rather than a canonical planner node. It is held to the same per-rule checks as every convention: a convention, strict, a failing fixture, relationship edges.

sharedNodes.text: Strict disposition: the rule fails on every finding; there is no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline.

additions.text: When removing or renaming an artifact, update every typed reference that points to it in the same change.
additions.justification: Direct operationalisation of the fix hint for the rename/removal case; adds no new obligation beyond 'references resolve'.

additions.text: Creating empty placeholder artifacts only to make a reference resolve without the relationship being real.
additions.justification: Metric-gaming anti-pattern required by the schema; follows from the normative text that the plan must be able to show the relationship.
